t: Dome Publishing - Wikipedia
s: May 25, 2025 - Dome Publishing is an American accounting publisher founded in 1940 by CPA Nicholas Picchione. The company publishes a series of ledgers designed to simplify the bookkeeping process for small businesses (especially those whose personnel are not experienced in bookkeeping and accounting), as well as software based on their ledgers and several ergonomic products for use in business and other settings.
